lead_independence.headline: Four candidates for Indian River County Commission District 2 outline positions on taxes, housing and growth
lead_independence.lead: Bob McPartian, who served 15 years on the Sebastian City Council, said the most serious issue is managing growth in a way that protects quality of life, infrastructure and the Indian River Lagoon. McPartian said he does not support the homestead exemption referendum as written because it was developed quickly without a full analysis of its impact. If it passes, McPartian said he would protect public safety and core infrastructure first, then look to reduce non-essential spending.

lead_independence.headline: Father arrested in Virginia in connection with Fort Pierce infant malnutrition death
lead_independence.lead: A fourth person has been arrested in connection with the death of a 3-month-old baby who allegedly died from severe dehydration and malnutrition. St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office announced Tuesday that the child's biological father, Jason Gunter, 45, was taken into custody by the United States Marshals Service at his home in Mechanicsville, Virginia. He has been charged with felony child neglect causing great harm and is awaiting extradition to St. Lucie County.

lead_independence.headline: U.S. Marshals arrest baby's father in connection with Fort Pierce malnutrition death
lead_independence.lead: St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office announced Tuesday that the biological father of a 3-month-old baby who allegedly died from severe dehydration and malnutrition has been arrested. Jason Gunter, 45, was taken into custody by the United States Marshals Service at his home in Mechanicsville, Virginia, and has been charged with felony child neglect causing great harm. He is awaiting extradition to St. Lucie County.
